title: Ashfall Showcase Flow
subtitle: Official Pack #1 guided first-play arc
summary: A compact path through Terminal, Index, Lens, HoloMap, MissionCore, WeatherCore, RelicTech, PowerGrid, Armory, and story hooks without leaking Ashfall into generic templates.
body: Start at the drop pod, open Terminal, read the Index survival archive, scan wreckage with Lens, pin the HoloMap field objective, accept the MissionCore recovery chain, survive the first toxic-front warning, recover a relic fragment, repair the pod power spine, install a basic Armory upgrade, then follow the first faction and chapter handoff marker.
